name: Looped mdlARC v3, d384 ×6
summary: d384 ×6 looped transformer with deep supervision; 80 views, top 20 voted candidates ranked by the model's likelihood.

code.command: python launch_run.py --config specs/data_squeeze/arc1_d384x6.json (arc2_d384x6.json for ARC-AGI-2), then the likelihood rescore of the saved candidates, as in specs/paper/rearc_and_scale/arc1_d384x6_rescore_eval.json

arc1.settings: 330 epochs, 80 decode views, leave-one-out demos; top 20 voted candidates ranked by likelihood
arc1.note: Candidates from a re-decode of the same checkpoint (plain votes 68.375 / 79.875); likelihood ranking took 0.33 GPU-hours. The original decode scored 68.375 by votes.

arc2.settings: 330 epochs, 80 decode views, leave-one-out demos; top 20 voted candidates ranked by likelihood
arc2.note: Plain votes score 13.889. Likelihood ranking took 0.35 GPU-hours.
